source.title: Russian gardener grows giant 360 - kg pumpkin

en.summary: A Russian gardener has grown a giant pumpkin weighing 360 kilograms, breaking local records.
en.why_irrelevant: It's an exotic agricultural feat far from typical urban or tech-focused feeds.

zh.summary: 一位俄罗斯园丁种出了一个重达360公斤的巨大南瓜，打破了当地纪录。
zh.why_irrelevant: 这是一项远离都市或科技类信息流的奇异农业成就。

brief: Today's headlines are dominated by concerns over the prolonged deployment of the USS Abraham Lincoln and its crew, with President Trump dismissing criticisms. Elsewhere, the tragic death of Cambridge professor Jason Arday, a Croatian wildfire, and political tensions around the Strait of Hormuz also feature prominently. In research, papers focus on innovation vs. cybersecurity, trust in AI for oncology, and ethical reporting in visualization science.
news_summary: The main stories include President Trump downplaying sailor welfare issues on USS Lincoln, the apparent suicide of Cambridge professor Jason Arday, a severe wildfire in Croatia, and threats to declare the Strait of Hormuz US territory. Additional items cover Hawaiian Electric warning of prolonged outages, political matters in Alaska, and a stock trading scandal in Congress.
papers_summary: Papers today address balancing rapid innovation with cybersecurity in regulated industries, improving trust in AI diagnostic tools in oncology, and analyzing ethics reporting in visualization research. Also notable are studies on palmitoylation in neuroblastoma differentiation and forensic analysis of industrial control systems.
